syllabus_topics: Heating up and cooling of electrical engines
Choosing electrical engines for specific production machines and aggregates – compressors, pumps, fans, etc.
Energetic of the electrical drives automation
Constructive features and regimes of operation of photoelectrical converters
Methods, resources and algorithms for control of electrical power engineering
Energy efficiency in the industrial sector
assessment_rules: Test control is written (current control), and the results of the individual work are considered, as well. At the written exam students work on two questions from the lectures, which helps to estimate their level of knowledge. Assessment is continuous.
